loom.agent/authored/a-bearer-env-that-is.purpose: An http binding whose bearer_env is not a variable name is refused without repeating it.

fields.detail: `bindings[2].bearer_env` is not an environment variable name

loom.agent/authored/a-blank-text-member-.purpose: An agent name of only whitespace is refused as blank text, naming the member.

fields.detail: `agent.name` is empty

loom.agent/authored/a-ca-file-over-one-m.purpose: A `LOOM_HTTP_CA_FILE` past 1048576 bytes is refused `TooLarge`, even holding certificates.

loom.agent/authored/a-ca-file-with-a-cer.purpose: A `LOOM_HTTP_CA_FILE` holding a certificate within 1048576 bytes extends the webpki roots.

loom.agent/authored/a-ca-file-with-no-ce.purpose: An empty `LOOM_HTTP_CA_FILE`, or one holding no certificate, is refused `NoCertificate`.

loom.agent/authored/a-deadline-that-is-n.purpose: A budget deadline that is a date alone is refused; a full RFC 3339 instant is serveable.

fields.detail: `session.budget.deadline` is not an RFC 3339 instant

loom.agent/authored/a-failing-status-ans.purpose: A 503 answer is a refused read.

loom.agent/authored/a-malformed-document.purpose: A document with a member the domain does not declare is refused as malformed, naming it.

loom.agent/authored/a-message-whose-turn.purpose: A message whose turn ran but was not recorded runs no second turn.

loom.agent/authored/a-missing-bearer-is-.purpose: A read whose bearer variable is unset, empty or blank is refused before any request.

loom.agent/authored/a-new-message-runs-o.purpose: A message whose item is not recorded runs one turn, recorded once.

loom.agent/authored/a-path-outside-allow.purpose: A read whose path the binding does not allow is refused before any request.

loom.agent/authored/a-port-outside-the-r.purpose: An A2A port of 0, and one of 65536, is refused as out of range, naming the member.

fields.detail: `expose.a2a.port` is not a port from 1 to 65535
`expose.a2a.port` is not a port from 1 to 65535

loom.agent/authored/a-post-on-an-http-bi.purpose: A read of an http binding whose method is POST is refused before any request.

loom.agent/authored/a-probe-needs-no-bea.purpose: A probe, `GET /ready` or `GET /live`, is answered without a bearer.

loom.agent/authored/a-redirect-is-not-fo.purpose: A 302 answer is a refused read, not a second request.

loom.agent/authored/a-repeated-message-r.purpose: A message whose item is recorded already is answered with the recorded line and runs no turn.

loom.agent/authored/a-request-with-the-b.purpose: A request carrying the agent's bearer is admitted.

loom.agent/authored/a-response-over-max-.purpose: A 200 answer one byte past max_bytes is cut.

loom.agent/authored/a-response-within-ma.purpose: A 200 answer within max_bytes is read whole.

loom.agent/authored/a-secret-literal-is-.purpose: A binding URL carrying a password is refused, naming the member and not the password.

fields.detail: a URL carrying a user name and password

loom.agent/authored/a-send-is-held-until.purpose: In approval mode a `reply.send` is held before the grant and admitted after it.

loom.agent/authored/a-send-outside-the-a.purpose: A `reply.send` whose channel is not in the allow list is refused before any process runs.

loom.agent/authored/a-send-with-writes-n.purpose: With `writes.mode: none` every `reply.send` is refused, finally.

loom.agent/authored/a-send-without-a-pro.purpose: A `reply.send` before a `reply.propose` for the item is refused; the run goes on.

loom.agent/authored/a-sixth-send-in-the-.purpose: With five sends in the hour and `max_per_hour: 5`, the next `reply.send` is refused.

loom.agent/authored/a-source-without-a-b.purpose: A state naming a source no binding declares is refused, naming the source.

fields.detail: tickets

loom.agent/authored/a-spec-exposing-a2a-.purpose: A spec declaring `expose.a2a` and no `channel` is served; it answers A2A and polls nothing.

loom.agent/authored/a-spec-with-a-channe.purpose: A spec declaring a `channel` is polled, and answers A2A beside the poll when it declares `expose.a2a`.

loom.agent/authored/a-spec-with-no-loops.purpose: A spec with no loops whose states inbound-answer@1 admits is serveable to the check.

loom.agent/authored/a-spec-with-nothing-.purpose: A spec declaring neither a `channel` nor `expose.a2a` is refused `NothingToServe`.

loom.agent/authored/a-spec-without-conne.purpose: The operator example without `runtime.connectors` and `deploy.kubernetes.image_repository` is serveable to the check.

loom.agent/authored/a-state-naming-an-un.purpose: A state naming an action operator-reply@1 does not declare is refused, naming it.

fields.detail: reply.escalate

loom.agent/authored/a-stream-without-the.purpose: A streaming request without the bearer is refused `MissingBearer`, one with another bearer `WrongBearer`.

loom.agent/authored/a-streamed-message-i.purpose: A streaming request carrying the agent's bearer is streamed.

loom.agent/authored/a-valid-spec-checks.purpose: The operator example is serveable, so `b10x-loom agent check` exits 0 on it.

loom.agent/authored/a-wrong-bearer-is-re.purpose: A request whose bearer is not the agent's is refused `WrongBearer`.

loom.agent/authored/an-allow-listed-get-.purpose: A GET of an allow-listed path is admitted.

loom.agent/authored/an-allow-path-holdin.purpose: An http binding allowing a path with a backslash dot-dot segment is refused as not a plain path.

fields.detail: `bindings[2].allow_paths[1]` is not a plain path, one that starts with `/` and holds no `\`, no `.` or `..` segment, no encoded separator or dot, no `?` or `#` and no whitespace

loom.agent/authored/an-empty-channel-all.purpose: An empty channel.allow is refused, naming the member.

fields.detail: no channel id is allowed

loom.agent/authored/an-http-binding-whos.purpose: An http binding with method POST is refused, naming the member.

fields.detail: POST

loom.agent/authored/an-unauthenticated-r.purpose: A request without an `Authorization` bearer is refused `MissingBearer`.

loom.agent/authored/an-unknown-format-is.purpose: A document whose format is not loom.agent/1 is refused, naming the format member.

fields.detail: `format` is `loom.agent/2`, not `loom.agent/1`

loom.agent/authored/an-unknown-protocol-.purpose: An inner loop on a protocol the plugin catalog does not hold is refused, naming it.

fields.detail: operator-escalate@1

loom.agent/authored/an-unreadable-ca-fil.purpose: A `LOOM_HTTP_CA_FILE` naming a file that cannot be read is refused `Unreadable`.

loom.agent/authored/an-unset-ca-file-kee.purpose: With no `LOOM_HTTP_CA_FILE` named, an `http` binding read trusts the webpki roots alone.

loom.agent/authored/budgets-hold.purpose: A turn that spends its budget is recorded stopped and the run ends with no answer.

loom.agent/authored/input-missing.purpose: An absent, unreadable or empty `--input` is refused before any model call.

loom.agent/authored/no-loops-runs-one-tu.purpose: A spec with no loops is checked against inbound-answer@1 and runs one turn that ends answered and sends nothing.

loom.agent/authored/one-turn-recorded.purpose: A spec served by neither a channel nor A2A runs one turn on the given task text and ends answered.

loom.agent/authored/refused-spec.purpose: A spec `CheckAgentSpec` refuses ends the run refused before any model call.

loom.agent/authored/reply-send-without-w.purpose: reply.send in policy.capabilities beside writes.mode none is refused, naming the member.

fields.detail: reply.send

loom.agent/authored/send-under-writes.purpose: Under `writes: {mode: auto, max_per_hour: 1}` the first run sends; the second inside the hour is refused.

loom.agent/authored/states-with-no-loops.purpose: States with no loops naming an action inbound-answer@1 does not declare are refused UnknownProtocol at states.

fields.detail: with no loops the states run on inbound-answer@1, which does not declare reply.send (states[0].actions[2])

loom.agent/authored/writes-zero-sends-no.purpose: With `writes.max_per_hour: 0` the run performs no send and is refused `RateLimited`.
